assign.request: Ask a minion to look into how to integrate all our imagine things with the core framework. Estimate the complexity, recommend renaming or restructuring to simplify architecture, UI, etc.
steps: Inventory every realm: what it is, what it built, sizes
Count inbound links per realm with rg
Trace what already graduated to core/ext/ui
Decide each realm's fate: module, doc, merge, delete
Rename table with url moves and break counts
Complexity per move, pick the top three

assign.now: inventory done - 24 realms counted, link census run

log.msg: Counted 24 directories under public/imagine/, not 27. The rail shows 25 columns because Start is written in place and has no directory. The brief's 27 reconciles as 24 + the two top-level realms that grew out of it (/layouts/, /websites/) + review/rethink.

THE BIG ONE: zero JavaScript imports cross into /imagine/ from anywhere else on the site. Every outside reference is a hyperlink in prose. The only hard code dependency is one string - export const DIR = "/imagine/generated/" in framework/core/Page/generator/export.js. So every move is import-safe; the entire cost of any restructure is rewriting links.

Link census: 576 live hyperlinks point into /imagine/ from the rest of the site (notes 213, layouts 187, framework 166, blog 10), plus roughly 1500 more inside framework/ai task logs which are history and stay untouched. Busiest destinations: design 118, paging 117, layouts 73, platform 71.

/layouts/ links into /imagine/ 187 times - the encyclopedia already reaches across the boundary for its own evidence (shells 33, paging 25, screens 26, design 21, sections 13). That is the measurement that says the boundary is in the wrong place.

Four kinds of thing share one rail, which is the whole reason a newcomer is lost: 6 tools you use, 7 worlds you play with, 7 shapes that say how to arrange a screen, 4 finished studies. Each kind already has a home in the framework.

The three moves. 1 (S): group the rail, one file, zero urls move. 2 (M): the 13 design studies join framework/styles/system, 59 files and 138 links. 3 (M): seven shape labs join /layouts/ and /imagine/layouts/ is deleted, 68 files and 402 links. Everything else is in the table; the six live tools are L and the owner decides.

Two realms are fail-safe - review and codrops have zero live links in. Everything else needs a six-line stub page.js at the old address, because production is static and core has no redirect. /layouts/ already serves an alias id as a working url, so the pattern exists.
Skipped the usage.json refresh: the write fence is this task dir only. Window was 4 percent at launch.

assign.outcome:
**A study: `/imagine/` is four kinds of thing sharing one rail, and nothing imports across its boundary.** 24 realms (not 27 — `Start` has no directory), 35,029 lines of JS and 8,752 of CSS, which is 45% of the whole framework's size sitting beside it.

**The fact that decides everything.** Not one `.js` file outside `public/imagine/` imports a module from inside it. Every outside reference is a hyperlink in prose, so no move can break a page — the entire cost of any restructure is rewriting 576 links. The one hard dependency in the repo is a single line: `export const DIR = "/imagine/generated/"` in `core/Page/generator/export.js`.

**Why a newcomer is lost.** The rail gives 24 identical cards to four unrelated kinds of thing: 6 **tools** you use, 7 **worlds** you play with, 7 **shapes** that say how to arrange a screen, and 4 finished **studies** whose verdicts already shipped. Each kind already has a home in the framework.

**The three moves.**
1. **S — Sort the rail into four groups.** One file, one hour, zero urls move, zero links break. Do it tonight whatever happens to the rest.
2. **M — The 13 design studies join the design system.** `styles/system/readme.md` currently links *out* to a lab to explain its own rule. 59 files, 138 links, no core code.
3. **M — Seven shape labs join `/layouts/`; `/imagine/layouts/` is deleted.** `/layouts/` already links *into* `/imagine/` 187 times for its own evidence — the boundary is in the wrong place. 68 files, 402 links.

**Deliverables.** [The proposal](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/imagine-integration/proposal/) — three moves, the full rename table with a break count per url, and the front page in five sentences. [The inventory](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/imagine-integration/inventory/) — a row for each of the 24 realms: what it is, what it proved, what graduated, what still uses it, lines of JS and CSS.

**Left for the owner.** The six live tools (`paging`/Make at 9,055 lines, `importance`, `research`, `stream`, plus `cms` and `generated`) are marked **L** on purpose: moving a tool into `ext/` changes what it *is*, and `ext/` has no member today that keeps files on disk the way Make does. That is a positioning call, not a refactor.

**Fail-safe:** `review` and `codrops` have zero live links in — they can move with no stub at all. Everything else needs a six-line stub `page.js` at the old address, because production is static and core has no redirect; `/layouts/` already serves an alias id as a working url, so the pattern exists.
